gates.name: activity_evidence_depth
gates.target: >=250 unique activity molecules for curated-grade; >=50 for useful starter
gates.recommendation: Use this demo only to inspect output shape. Add measured activity data before trusting rankings.

gates.name: toxicity_selectivity_depth
gates.recommendation: Add measured cytotoxicity, hemolysis, environmental, or selectivity data before review.

gates.name: label_density
gates.recommendation: Demo labels are synthetic placeholders, not measured endpoints.

gates.name: source_diversity
gates.recommendation: Combine uploaded data, CleanMol literature extraction, ChEMBL/PubChem, and HF safety sources.

gates.name: modern_source_presence
gates.recommendation: Pull or upload current public/experimental sources before calling a packet review-ready.

gates.name: organism_or_assay_breadth
gates.target: >=3 organism/assay groups, ideally Gram-positive, Gram-negative, fungal/biofilm
gates.recommendation: This demo shows breadth labels only; measured assay evidence is still required.

gates.name: modern_seed_depth
gates.recommendation: Add more modern QAC, gemini, phosphonium, pyridinium, imidazolium, and safety-negative seeds.

gates.name: scaffold_diversity
gates.recommendation: Add scaffold diversity before using rankings for real triage.

gates.name: synthetic_prior_separation
gates.recommendation: This packet is intentionally synthetic and should never be treated as curated-grade.

gates.name: candidate_quality
gates.target: >=80% of top 20 candidates modern_seed and >=20 ranked candidates
gates.recommendation: Increase candidate count and measured evidence before lab review.
